notes.title: Language support added for German, French, Russian, & Spanish
notes.notes:
You can now anomaly hunt in multiple languages. SEEING THINGS now fully supports German, French, Russian, and Spanish! The next time you launch the game, or the first time you ever launch the game, you will be presented with the language select option. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710106/20d127b419c6c9547899aa777863863c1d34311d.gif[/img]

After you select it the first time, that'll be the language used for all subsequent plays. You can change the selected language at any time in the Options menu. Hope you enjoy!

notes.title: Steam Deck compatibility for SEEING THINGS
notes.notes:
SEEING THINGS has been tested, played, and loved on the Steam Deck! You are now able to play with a mouse and keyboard, a controller, or on a Steam Deck ːsteamhappyː 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710106/98bdc5774f4924e4806dbe8ee46ddfa16a762722.jpg[/img]

We've mapped the following default config profile for Steam Deck: 

- Left and right bumpers: change rooms
- Left and right trackpads: drive the mouse around (it’s cool!)
- Left and right trackpad click: click
- L2 / R2: click
- Two options button: Pause

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710106/1289e083c11744c2dc9533c9a0c12469bccd7c2d.jpg[/img]

Enjoy!

notes.title: Seeing Things demo v0.01
notes.notes:
Version 0.01 of the Seeing Things demo is out now!

The biggest change is that anomalies won't appear in your current room. That is, if you're viewing a particular room and an anomaly is set to appear, it will not appear until you view another room and return back.

A smaller but important change is that we added volume controls in the menu settings -- more settings to come. ːsteamhappyː
